# CreationDisposition

The `CreationDisposition` values exposed by this package.

```rux
pub enum CreationDisposition: uint32 {
    CreateNew = 1,
    CreateAlways = 2,
    OpenExisting = 3,
    OpenAlways = 4,
    TruncateExisting = 5
}
```

## Cases

| Name               | Value | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CreateNew`        | `1`   | Create the file, and fail with [`ERROR_FILE_EXISTS`](/docs/api/windows/errors#error-file-exists) if the name is taken.                                                                                                                                           |
| `CreateAlways`     | `2`   | Create the file, truncating whatever is there. Succeeds either way, and reports [`ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS`](/docs/api/windows/errors#error-already-exists) through [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error) when it truncated rather than created. |
| `OpenExisting`     | `3`   | Open the file, and fail with [`ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND`](/docs/api/windows/errors#error-file-not-found) if it is not there.                                                                                                                                         |
| `OpenAlways`       | `4`   | Open the file, creating it if it is not there. Reports [`ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS`](/docs/api/windows/errors#error-already-exists) when it opened rather than created.                                                                                               |
| `TruncateExisting` | `5`   | Open the file and truncate it, failing if it is not there. Needs write access.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
